description: Scopes the in-app recipe-import browser. The 'recipe-capture' window loads an arbitrary, untrusted recipe page, so its injected capture script is granted the bare minimum: emit a Tauri event (to hand the captured page HTML back to the app) and nothing else — no file, shell, window, or other command access. 'remote.urls' is required for the loaded remote origin's IPC to work at all; the only thing it can reach is core event emit.
